title: Changelog
text:
Version History

v0.1.1

Preloads dhw layer on startup
Camera zoom preset to Indonesia
Tooltip formatting cleanup
Active button state + hover highlighting improved
Default date: static date − 2 days (stable availability)
Padding and layout polish (buttons, sliders)



v0.1.0

Adds live date picker widget
Dynamic WMS switching based on metric and date
Buttons arranged in rows with spacing
Improved tooltip styling (lat/lon + data)
Adds custom geocoder handler



v0.0.6

Adds CRW PNG tile support (GCS format)
WMS + tile dual-layer structure
Parses GetFeatureInfo XML to extract readable values
Metric IDs mapped to display names



v0.0.5

Modularized WMS/tile layer control
Picker click/tooltip more robust
Alpha slider now tracks active layer



v0.0.4

Adds tooltip GetFeatureInfo support
Implements lat/lon hover display
Layer click sampling integrated



v0.0.3.1

Minor fixes to 0.0.3
Button interaction more stable



v0.0.3

Adds metric buttons (SST, DHW, SSTA, BAA)
Introduces dynamic layer switching



v0.0.2

Alpha slider added
Simple toggle between hardcoded WMS layers



v0.0.1

Initial setup: Cesium viewer with single hardcoded WMS
No interaction, static display only

title: d3
text:
Visualizes NOAA Coral Reef Watch DHW (Degree Heating Weeks) data from a NetCDF4 .nc file as an interactive global map using D3.js and h5wasm.

Load Libraries: • Uses h5wasm to read HDF5/NetCDF4 files directly in the browser. • Uses d3 for data-driven map visualization.
Load Remote DHW Dataset: • Fetches a daily NOAA CoralTemp NetCDF file for March 30, 2025. • Saves it as “dhw.nc” in the browser’s virtual file system.
Parse NetCDF File: • Opens the file with h5wasm.File(…). • Extracts: • degree_heating_week values • Latitude (lat) and longitude (lon) dimensions.
Extract GeoJSON Points: • Iterates through every 20th pixel to reduce density. • Skips invalid or missing values. • Creates a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of points with: • Coordinates • DHW values
Render with D3: • Sets up a geoNaturalEarth1 map projection. • Draws each point as a colored circle scaled by DHW. • Color uses the YlOrRd (Yellow–Orange–Red) gradient.
Add Tooltip: • Shows lat, lon, and DHW on hover.
Add Legend: • Horizontal color bar showing DHW scale from 0–12 °C-weeks.
